import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModNumber {
        int val;

        ModNumber(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            this.val = (int) v;
        }

        static int modInverse(int a, int m) {
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                int tmp = g % r; g = r; r = tmp;
                int tmpX = x - q * y; x = y; y = tmpX;
            }
            return x < 0 ? x + m : x;
        }

        ModNumber add(ModNumber other) {
            int res = this.val + other.val;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModNumber(res);
        }

        ModNumber subtract(ModNumber other) {
            int res = this.val - other.val;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new ModNumber(res);
        }

        ModNumber multiply(ModNumber other) {
            long res = (long) this.val * other.val % MOD;
            return new ModNumber(res);
        }

        ModNumber divide(ModNumber other) {
            return this.multiply(new ModNumber(modInverse(other.val, MOD)));
        }

        ModNumber inv() {
            return new ModNumber(modInverse(this.val, MOD));
        }

        ModNumber pow(long p) {
            ModNumber base = this;
            ModNumber result = new ModNumber(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) result = result.multiply(base);
                base = base.multiply(base);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof ModNumber)) return false;
            ModNumber other = (ModNumber) o;
            return this.val == other.val;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Integer.hashCode(val);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        ModNumber[][] prob = new ModNumber[N][N];

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split("\\s+");
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(parts[j]);
                prob[i][j] = new ModNumber(p).divide(new ModNumber(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> count_masks = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            count_masks.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        int[] lookup = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(lookup, -1);
        for (int m = 0; m < (1 << N); m++) {
            int c = Integer.bitCount(m);
            lookup[m] = count_masks.get(c).size();
            count_masks.get(c).add(m);
        }

        Map<Long, ModNumber> current_masks = new HashMap<>();
        long initial_mask = 1L << lookup[0];
        current_masks.put(initial_mask, new ModNumber(1));

        for (int l = 0; l < N; l++) {
            Map<Long, ModNumber> next_masks = new HashMap<>();
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
                ModNumber prod = new ModNumber(1);
                for (int r = 0; r < N; r++) {
                    boolean bit_set = ((mask >> r) & 1) == 1;
                    if (bit_set) {
                        prod = prod.multiply(prob[l][r]);
                    } else {
                        prod = prod.multiply(new ModNumber(1).subtract(prob[l][r]));
                    }
                }
                for (Map.Entry<Long, ModNumber> p : current_masks.entrySet()) {
                    long msk = p.getKey();
                    ModNumber pval = p.getValue();
                    long new_msk = 0;
                    for (int m : count_masks.get(l)) {
                        if (((msk >> lookup[m]) & 1) == 1) {
                            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1 && ((m >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                                    new_msk |= 1L << lookup[m | (1 << i)];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    long key = new_msk;
                    next_masks.put(key, next_masks.getOrDefault(key, new ModNumber(0)).add(pval.multiply(prod)));
                }
            }
            current_masks = next_masks;
        }

        ModNumber total = new ModNumber(0);
        int last_idx = lookup[(1 << N) - 1];
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModNumber> p : current_masks.entrySet()) {
            long key = p.getKey();
            if (((key >> last_idx) & 1) == 1) {
                total = total.add(p.getValue());
            }
        }
        System.out.println(total.val);
    }
}
